Abkhazia, GADM's GEO.1_1. geosiwk's card is the breakaway Republic of Abkhazia, and its capital (Sukhumi, which Wikidata Q2914461 gives as Sokhumi), native names and note describe the territory either way; https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q2914461.
